# Build template from all seeds in demo1: pattern per cell = seed cells, bottom-aligned to 4x4
def get_tm(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr={i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=0}
    sc={j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] and g[0][j]!=0 for i in range(H))}
    rb=[ [i for i in range(H) if i not in sr and (i==max([x for x in range(i+1)]) or True)] ] 
    return None
# simpler: band rows are groups of consecutive non-sep rows; template = union shape across all bands' seeds
def tm_shape(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seprows=sorted({i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=0})
    srows=set(seprows)
    # union over all non-sep rows, non-sep cols, excluding the seed color itself
    seedcells=[]
    seen=set()
    for i in range(H):
        if i in srows: continue
        for j in range(W):
            if j in {4,9}: continue
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=0 and v!=sepcolor:
                seedcells.append((i,j,v))
    return seedcells
